title: Minimum site area of a rear battleaxe site (Table 3B)
text: Minimum and average site area. C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 3B and the following provisions. Table 3B Site area requirements. Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe (m2): R2 -; R2.5 -; R5 -; R10 925; R12.5 762.5; R15 655; R17.5 587.5; R20 450; R25 425; R30 410; R35 395; R40 380; R50 160; R60 120; R80 100; R100-SL -. R80 site area provisions apply to all grouped dwellings located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. Site area variations. Site area variations are subject to C4.1.1. C4.1.4 The following variations to the minimum and average site area set out in Table 3B may be made: i. in the case of a grouped dwelling; the area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC; or ii. the area of any existing lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with permanent legal access to a public road, notwithstanding that it is less than that required in Table 3B.

exceptions.label: C4.1.4(i) area of a lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot approved by the WAPC
C4.1.4(ii) existing lot with permanent legal access to a public road

verified.note: Battleaxe values checked. C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 reduce 'the minimum and average site area of Table 3B'; whether that reaches the 'Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe' column is not stated on the page (p53-54). Whether the column, formerly limited to single houses, is meant to apply to grouped dwellings is register query ch3-089.

notes: diverges: Table 3B (p54) for Table 2B; test otherwise as the Chapter 2 twin. With the current 'only applies to single houses' footnote removed, the minimum lot area/rear battleaxe column reads as applying to a grouped dwelling on a rear battleaxe site (ch3-089 asks whether this is intended; verify). Area per C4.1.3(ii)-(iv). R2-R5 and R100-SL: null.
